massage-studio.title: One massage studio and one calendar

acceptance_criteria: Seeding twice produces one professional and no duplicate options.
A distinct positive duration can be inserted without code changes. Duplicate type and duration pairs are rejected.
MS-01.description:
Why / Intent
Requirements 1–3. Make the business editable as data.

Start Boundary
An empty demo PostgreSQL database and the current Alembic setup.

End Boundary
The seeded catalog and working intervals can be queried twice with identical results.

Owner
Business schema and seed.

Migration Owner
This task owns the fresh schema for the professional, options and calendar. No booking backfill is required.

Inputs
One massagista, the example service rows, the demo timezone, working intervals, prices and buffers. Use the existing bot registration flow for one bot.

Outputs / Side-effects
One active professional, one row per type and duration, stable IDs and repeatable seed data. Keep blocked periods available.

Non-goals
New admin UI, additional bot registration logic, graph and model changes.

Focused Verification
On a dedicated empty test database run alembic upgrade head, then python -m app.seed twice. Check catalog counts and uniqueness, then insert a 45-minute option and read it through the catalog.
evidence: Full test suite: 142 passed with disposable PostgreSQL, Redis and RabbitMQ.
Fresh migration and seed exercised by integration tests.
MS-01.title: Set up the massagista, services, and calendar

acceptance_criteria: A 30-minute service plus a 15-minute buffer fits a 45-minute opening. A 60-minute service cannot use it.
Two overlapping requests for different services produce at most one committed booking.
Cancellation frees time, failed rescheduling preserves the appointment and repeated approval cannot duplicate it.
MS-02.description:
Why / Intent
Requirements 2–4. Make offered times match the chosen massage.

Start Boundary
The seeded catalog and working intervals from MS-01.

End Boundary
The current booking flow saves, displays and manages appointments using one shared calendar.

Owner
Catalog, availability and booking queries.

Migration Owner
MS-01 owns the business schema.

Inputs
Existing catalog requests, service ID, working intervals, occupied intervals and verified customer identity.

Outputs / Side-effects
Return the same catalog and slot fields the graph consumes. Snapshot the booked interval, enforce ownership and reject overlaps during the booking transaction.

Non-goals
Graph nodes, prompts, inference, new duration-extraction behavior and Telegram architecture.

Focused Verification
Run pytest -q tests/unit/test_scheduling.py tests/integration/test_postgres_booking_lifecycle.py tests/integration/test_telegram_ownership.py tests/unit/test_gemma_laya.py against test services.
evidence: Full test suite: 142 passed with disposable PostgreSQL, Redis and RabbitMQ.
Fresh migration and seed exercised by integration tests.
MS-02.title: Book each option on the shared calendar

acceptance_criteria: The journey produces immediate replies and no reminder work.
The fresh install and owner agenda work without reminder tables or a reminder worker.
The existing graph and model tests still pass with the new example data.
MS-03.description:
Why / Intent
Requirements 4–5. Keep booking replies and the owner's agenda.

Start Boundary
The massage booking lifecycle from MS-02.

End Boundary
A clean demo deployment completes a booking journey with immediate replies and no reminder worker, inbox or scheduled jobs.

Owner
Booking side effects, reminder delivery and demo documentation.

Migration Owner
This task owns retirement of reminder storage and dependent columns on the fresh schema.

Inputs
Existing reminder writes, owner CLI, reminder-only sender and scheduler paths, Compose services and demo fixtures.

Outputs / Side-effects
Remove reminder-only code, tables, jobs, metrics and CLI settings. Retain ordinary reply delivery and the owner agenda. Update affected tests and walkthrough.

Non-goals
Changes to generic message processing infrastructure, the model stack or unrelated tests.

Focused Verification
Run pytest -q tests/integration/test_workflow_booking_journey.py tests/integration/test_telegram_production.py with test services. Walk through book, reschedule and cancel, read the agenda and check the reply path and final schema.
evidence: Full test suite: 142 passed with disposable PostgreSQL, Redis and RabbitMQ.
Fresh migration and seed exercised by integration tests.
